title: Press Release: Recently Unsealed Trial Evidence Contradicts Government’s Account of Events During Fourth of July Prairieland Noise Protest
content:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:

 July 20, 2026




Recently Unsealed Trial Evidence Contradicts Government’s Account of Events During Fourth of July Prairieland Noise Protest




DFW Support Committee Highlights Key Video Footage for Public, Which Federal Judge Mark Pittman Kept Under Seal for Weeks After Trial




FORT WORTH, TX

 — Four months after the federal Prairieland verdicts, and a year after the Fourth of July noise demonstration held in solidarity with ICE Detention Center detainees, around which the Prairieland case revolves, the DFW Support Committee was able to piece together trial evidence to debunk government claims and refute rampant mischaracterizations in the media of that night’s events.




The US District Court for the Northern District of Texas, which recently sentenced nine federal trial defendants to consecutive terms of 30-100 years in prison, kept key evidence sealed for weeks after the March trial had concluded. Until now, this evidence has not been widely viewed by the public. The DFW Support Committee has highlighted certain video evidence that shows the July 4 demonstration was not an ambush or an attack—the dominant narrative coming from the government and uncritically repeated by mainstream media.
